source_caption:
📺 Don’t Trust the B–– in Apartment 23 (2012–2013)

Don’t Trust the B–– in Apartment 23 follows June Colburn, an optimistic young woman who moves to New York City hoping to begin an exciting new chapter of her life. However, when her dream job unexpectedly falls apart, June finds herself searching for a place to live and ends up sharing an apartment with Chloe, a charming but wildly unpredictable party girl who has a reputation for manipulating people and causing chaos. Unlike June, Chloe lives by her own rules, enjoys outrageous adventures, and has absolutely no problem making life difficult for everyone around her. Despite their completely opposite personalities, the two women gradually develop an unexpected friendship filled with hilarious misunderstandings, ridiculous schemes, awkward relationships, and unforgettable moments. Adding to the madness is Chloe’s best friend, actor James Van Der Beek, who plays an exaggerated version of himself. Starring Krysten Ritter, Dreama Walker, James Van Der Beek, and Liza Lapira, the series delivers outrageous comedy, memorable characters, and entertaining lessons about friendship, independence, relationships, and surviving life in New York City.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Sitcom • Dark Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creator: Nahnatchka Khan

📺 Seasons: 2 • 26 Episodes

📚 Setting: New York City, following the chaotic friendship between two completely different roommates.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and other digital retailers for current streaming or purchase availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Don't Trust the B— in Apartment 23 is an American television sitcom created by Nahnatchka Khan. It was broadcast on ABC between April 11, 2012, and September 6, 2014, comprising two seasons and 26 episodes. Originally a mid-season replacement, the network renewed the series for a second season in May 2012; six episodes from the first season were aired as part of the second without regard for continuity. In the story, Krysten Ritter stars as Chloe, an irresponsible party girl who searches for roommates by asking for rent up front and then behaving outrageously until they leave.
